title: Stripe 2026-09-30.endive requires an object for billing_cycle_anchor on subscription updates
summary: From API version 2026-09-30.endive, billing_cycle_anchor on Subscription update and resume (and subscription_details.billing_cycle_anchor on Invoice create_preview) takes an object with a type instead of the strings now and unchanged, so requests sending the old string form fail.
migrationNote: When moving to 2026-09-30.endive, send billing_cycle_anchor: {type: 'now'} instead of 'now' and {type: 'unchanged'} instead of 'unchanged' when updating or resuming a subscription. For a preview invoice of a new subscription anchored to a timestamp, send {type: 'timestamp', timestamp: <unix seconds>}.
